news.title: trunk/8e9dd78a4c841b620722b053c50d86dcb3690832: [XPU] Fix the static launcher leaking every loaded XPU kernel (#200890)
news.dek:
Motivation 
 _StaticXpuLauncher._load_kernel  leaks every kernel it loads.  PyCapsule_New  returns a new reference and  Py_BuildValue 's  "O"  takes a second one, so the capsule's refcount never reaches 0 and its destructor never runs.  close()  and the autotuner's launcher relea
news.aiSummary: The static XPU launcher was leaking memory because PyCapsule_New and Py_BuildValue created duplicate references, preventing the capsule's reference count from reaching zero. This prevented the destructor from running, causing every loaded kernel to remain in memory. The patch addresses this reference counting issue to ensure proper cleanup.
